rationale: C06 plausibly supplied the child’s central drafting architecture: acknowledge the merits of a particular local claim or project, identify the broader national policy and precedent it would establish, argue that the issue requires comprehensive study rather than piecemeal resolution, and defer action pending recommendations from an ongoing Executive-branch review. C11 is also close in opposing isolated tax relief while broader tax-policy recommendations are being prepared, but it lacks C06’s especially strong precedent-and-study sequence. C02 concerns local taxation of federal property and undesirable precedent, but its objection is narrower and does not use the child’s broad-review machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the claim covered in this bill is not unique... other communities may be expected to press similar... claims
shared_material.parent_excerpt: They will be precedents for other water supply projects which may be constructed in the future in other States
shared_material.explanation: Both move from a seemingly local measure to its likely precedential effect on comparable claims elsewhere.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Since this involves the question of modifying a long established policy, I believe that it should be decided broadly and deliberately, rather than through a succession of piece-meal decisions on individual requests.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Because of the complex nature of the problems involved, they should have the most careful study before this project is authorized, in order to make sure that the policies established for this one project are indeed equitable and form a desirable precedent for future work of a similar nature.
shared_material.explanation: The operative rationale is substantially the same: do not establish national policy through an individual project or request before deliberate examination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such a decision can best be reached in the light of the general suggestions which will be derived from the work of the Commission on Intergovernmental Relations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am having the various policy questions investigated further within the Executive Branch, and expect to submit fully considered recommendations to the next session of the Congress.
shared_material.explanation: Both defer the specific measure while a broader governmental study develops recommendations for uniform policy.
